verdict.rationale: Increase offers APIs, webhooks, and real-time decision callbacks that a developer could use to build their own background automations on their own servers. Those are developer building blocks, not a product feature for setting up autonomous automations. Built-in behaviors like automatic reconciliation via unique Account Numbers and auto-correlated returns are fixed adjacent features, not user-configurable automations. The pack documents no scheduled transfers, rules engine, or automation builder that runs in the background.
